name: gpt-audio-plugin
description: Generate, transform, and analyze music through Replicate with task-based model routing.

interface.shortDescription: Generate, transform, or analyze attached music.
interface.longDescription: Stay in the normal ChatGPT conversation and use GPTAudioMCP to generate new music, transform reference audio, continue a musical idea, or listen to attached audio for grounded critique. Replicate remains the single provider while the MCP routes each task to a suitable model.
defaultPrompt: Generate instrumental game music from our current conversation.
Use the audio file I attached as a reference and transform it according to our discussion.
Listen to the audio file I attached and critique the arrangement, instrumentation, structure, mood, and production.
